component.name: Replicate
component.summary: Restore SQL Server databases from VHD images

description.p: Replicate creates a Windows VM with SQL Server on your Linux machine, in the background, through libvirt and KVM. Point it at VHD or VHDX images (from SQL Clone, Hyper-V, or anything else that makes them) and it attaches copy-on-write clones of them to the VM and turns the data files or backups on them into databases.

Start and stop the VM, or just the SQL Server services inside it; add any other SQL Server you can reach; link servers to each other; and watch what they are doing with live charts and a statement trace built on Extended Events.
